title: AI Conscience Intermediate Certificate (v1)
description: A signed JSON certificate (NOT X.509) binding an online intermediate signing key to the offline root. The signature is a detached Ed25519 signature by the ROOT key over the canonical form of this document: keys sorted alphabetically, the signature field removed, serialised as JSON with no whitespace.

schema.description: Identifier of the schema this document conforms to.

key_id.description: Human-readable identifier for this intermediate key.

public_key.description: The intermediate signing key's public half, in SPKI PEM form.

fingerprint.description: First 8 bytes of SHA-256 of the intermediate public key's SPKI DER, lowercase hex.

issuer_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the ROOT key that signed this certificate.

not_before.description: The certificate is not valid before this instant; attestations must be signed at or after it.

not_after.description: The certificate is not valid after this instant; attestations must be signed at or before it.

signature.description: Base64 detached Ed25519 signature by the ROOT key over the canonical form of this document.
